title: Custom Car Radio (3D print)
oneLine: A head unit housing I modelled and printed so a modern radio would fit an older dashboard.

hero.alt: Generated stand-in image for Custom Car Radio (3D print). Not a photograph of the real build.

intake.question: What is it, in one sentence?
intake.hint: What it is and which vehicle it goes in.

intake.question: What made it hard?
intake.hint: Fitting an unknown cavity, tolerance, heat, or the electronics.

intake.question: What did you decide, and what did you reject?
intake.hint: How you captured the dash geometry, material choice, and what you rejected.

intake.question: What number can you put on it?
intake.hint: Number of print revisions, tolerance achieved in mm, print time, filament cost, gap at the trim edge.

intake.question: What broke, and what did you do?
intake.hint: The revisions that did not fit and what you measured differently.

intake.question: What media do you have?
intake.hint: CAD, the print iterations lined up in a row, and it installed in the dash. A row of failed revisions is a great photo.

intake.question: What would you do differently?
intake.hint: Two sentences. Not self criticism, a design judgement you would make differently now.
